issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מִגִּבְעַת הַמּוֹרֶה' means 'from the hill of Moreh' (גִּבְעַת = hill of, הַמּוֹרֶה = Moreh, a proper name). The Chinese renders it as '雨山丘' ('Rain Hill'), which is a mistranslation of the proper name 'Moreh' as if it were the common noun 'מוֹרֶה' (rain). This changes the place name.
